message.content: {"candidates":[{"sequence":"KQWSTPGNFK","hypothesis":"10 aa; polar/aromatic turn probe targeting exposed T64/V66, with P-G providing a compact bend. De novo hypothesis; no first-round evidence was supplied.","expected_discrimination":"Test accommodation of MSA V66–G68 spacing (5.5 Å) versus 8A9L (5.2 Å) and 6CU7 (5.9 Å); differences are small, so selectivity is uncertain."},{"sequence":"EKWNTDGNWQK","hypothesis":"11 aa; D-G turn alternative with two aromatic contacts and polar flanks; avoids requiring accessible N65.","expected_discrimination":"Targets the shared MSA T64/V66 exposure while testing their surrounding bend against both controls; SASA differences alone cannot establish selectivity."},{"sequence":"KSWQNGTFSQEK","hypothesis":"12 aa; flexible polar loop with separated aromatic anchors to tolerate all three MSA conformers.","expected_discrimination":"Tests the MSA T64–V70 span of 9.0–9.1 Å versus 9.5 Å in 8A9L and 8.8 Å in 6CU7; flexibility may reduce discrimination."},{"sequence":"EQYSPNGTWQK","hypothesis":"11 aa; P-N-G turn tests a more constrained shape-complementary interface around T64/V66/G67.","expected_discrimination":"Seek preference for the shared MSA V66–G68 bend, rather than the slightly tighter 8A9L or wider 6CU7 geometry."},{"sequence":"KQFTPGSQYTNKE","hypothesis":"13 aa; turn-centered polar/aromatic scaffold with charged termini and limited hydrophobic clustering.","expected_discrimination":"Tests simultaneous T64/V66 anchoring and peripheral V70 contact at the MSA T64–V70 span; both controls present shifted spans."},{"sequence":"EQTWQSTNQFKK","hypothesis":"12 aa; hydrogen-bond-rich candidate pairing T64 recognition with a single principal V66-facing aromatic contact.","expected_discrimination":"T64/V66 are exposed across MSA; weaker control compatibility is a hypothesis based on their lower exposure and surrounding geometry, not validated docking."},{"sequence":"KQYTSQNGSQFTEK","hypothesis":"14 aa; compliant polar scaffold designed to avoid dependence on N65, which is poorly exposed in 6XYP/6XYQ.","expected_discrimination":"Favor common T64/V66 anchors plus MSA V66–G68 spacing; test whether 8A9L and 6CU7 disrupt the cooperative contact network."},{"sequence":"EQWQTSHNTQYQKE","hypothesis":"14 aa; histidine-containing polar alternative tests adjustable hydrogen bonding near T64 without assigning an unsupported salt bridge.","expected_discrimination":"Seek cooperative recognition of the MSA bend; both controls differ at V66–G68, but histidine-mediated selectivity and pH sensitivity require testing."},{"sequence":"KSTFQGNSYTQENK","hypothesis":"14 aa; serine/threonine-rich soluble candidate with distributed aromatic contacts and a flexible central hinge.","expected_discrimination":"Test MSA T64–V70 geometry while avoiding reliance on V63/N65 exposure, which varies substantially within MSA; either control may remain compatible."},{"sequence":"EQNWTSTQNGFQSTK","hypothesis":"15 aa; extended polar anchoring alternative allowing backbone contacts near G67 while leaving buried G68/A69 largely unengaged.","expected_discrimination":"Tests joint T64/V66/G67 recognition; 6CU7 has less exposed G67, whereas 8A9L discrimination must come primarily from shape."},{"sequence":"KEQWSPGTFQEK","hypothesis":"12 aa; approximately charge-balanced, turn-constrained candidate using isolated aromatics rather than a continuous hydrophobic patch.","expected_discrimination":"Electrostatics mainly support solubility; proposed selectivity rests on MSA V66–G68 spacing versus both controls, not target charge differences."},{"sequence":"EKSYQTPGNWQSEK","hypothesis":"14 aa; balanced-charge P-G turn variant tests reduced conformational freedom while maintaining polar T64-facing functionality.","expected_discrimination":"A constrained bend may penalize both the tighter 8A9L and wider 6CU7 V66–G68 geometry; prediction must verify the contact register."},{"sequence":"KKQWSTNGQFYQKK","hypothesis":"14 aa; moderately cationic alternative tests whether solvent-facing lysines improve availability of a polar/aromatic binding face.","expected_discrimination":"No charged target residues support direct electrostatic discrimination; require MSA-shaped contacts and check nonspecific association with both controls."},{"sequence":"EEQYTPGNFQSTEE","hypothesis":"14 aa; anionic counterpart tests solubility and nonspecific-binding suppression while preserving a compact turn and two hydrophobic contacts.","expected_discrimination":"Any preference must arise from T64/V66-centered shape complementarity, not patch charge; test against both controls explicitly."},{"sequence":"KEQSWTNQPGTQFNSQTEK","hypothesis":"19 aa; longer, polar-flanked alternative tests multivalent engagement without a hydrophobic run or cysteine chemistry.","expected_discrimination":"Seek simultaneous MSA T64/V66 anchoring and peripheral contact consistent with T64–V70 at 9.0–9.1 Å. Both controls shift this span; extra flexibility could erase preference, and differing assembly layer counts confound SASA comparisons."}]}
